file_discovery.description: Find, list and inspect local files and folders without changing them.

file_content.description: Read, create or edit text files.

file_management.description: Create, copy, rename, move or delete local files and folders.

web_research.description: Research factual questions, find web links or inspect a webpage without opening a browser.

web_navigation.description: Open a website or search results in the browser, or download a file.

browser_interaction.description: Interact with pages in Alfred's managed browser: open, inspect, switch tabs, click, fill, download, go back.

documents.description: Extract text from PDF or images and search document contents.

applications.description: Open an app or local target, list running windows, close a selected window.

media_audio.description: Play music, control media playback, set or inspect system volume.

computer_system.description: Inspect computer information or restart/shut down Alfred or the computer.

clipboard.description: Read or replace text in the Windows clipboard.

network.description: Diagnose a network host, DNS and TCP reachability.

reminders.description: Schedule, list and cancel local reminders and completion notifications.

visual.description: Inspect the current screen or camera through Alfred's vision tools.

development.description: Pass a coding task to the Codex CLI for work in Alfred's project.

search_files.description: Find files or folders by name fragment. Return exact paths; use before acting on unclear targets.

args.query: name fragment; empty string lists all

list_directory.description: List the direct contents of one exact directory.

file_info.description: Get path, type, size and modification time for one exact file or folder.

search_file_contents.description: Find a literal text fragment inside UTF-8 files under a directory, returning exact paths and line numbers.

file_hash.description: Calculate SHA-256 for an exact local file, for integrity checks and duplicates.

read_text_file.description: Read a small UTF-8 text file.

create_text_file.description: Create a new UTF-8 text file without overwriting an existing one.

append_text_file.description: Append text to an existing UTF-8 file.

replace_text_file.description: Replace all contents of an existing UTF-8 file.

create_directory.description: Create one new folder inside an existing parent folder.

copy_path.description: Copy an exact file or folder to a new path without overwriting.

rename_path.description: Rename or move an exact file or folder to a new path without overwriting.

delete_path.description: Permanently delete an exact file or folder, including its contents.

create_zip.description: Compress an exact file or directory into a new ZIP file without overwriting.

extract_zip.description: Extract an exact ZIP into a new directory; refuse unsafe archive paths and existing destinations.

web_answer.description: Research a factual question online and answer in chat with evidence.

args.question: complete question with subject and context

search_web_links.description: Find web pages and return titles, URLs and snippets without opening a browser.

read_web_page.description: Read visible text from one HTTP(S) webpage.

check_url_status.description: Check whether an HTTP(S) URL responds and report status and content type.

open_browser.description: Open search results in the user's browser.

open_target.description: Open an app, existing local file/folder, or HTTP(S) website. Executable files require confirmation.

args.target: app name, exact path or URL

download_file.description: Start a tracked background download from a direct HTTP(S) URL; report progress by job ID and announce completion.

list_windows.description: List visible running windows with exact process IDs, names and titles.

list_processes.description: List running processes with names and process IDs, including those without visible windows.

list_installed_apps.description: List apps detected from Windows Start menu shortcuts.

close_window.description: Force close a selected window; unsaved work can be lost. First list_windows.

play_music.description: Play a song, artist, playlist or genre in YouTube Music.

set_volume.description: Set system volume to an exact percentage from 0 to 100.

system_info.description: Report local operating system and available disk space.

current_time.description: Report the computer's exact current local date, time and timezone.

system_control.description: Restart or shut down Alfred or the computer.

read_clipboard.description: Read current text from the Windows clipboard.

write_clipboard.description: Put text into the Windows clipboard, replacing its current contents.

inspect_screen.description: Describe or answer a question about the current computer screen.

inspect_camera.description: Describe or answer a question about the camera view.

run_codex.description: Ask Codex CLI to carry out a coding task in Alfred's project.

move_to_trash.description: Move an exact file or folder to Alfred's recoverable trash.

list_trash.description: List items in Alfred's recoverable trash with IDs and original paths.

restore_trash.description: Restore one item from Alfred's trash to its original path if vacant.

backup_file.description: Create a separate timestamped backup of an exact file, without overwriting.

replace_text_in_file.description: Replace a literal text fragment in one UTF-8 file; record an undo copy.

args.all: boolean, whether to replace all occurrences

undo_last_text_edit.description: Restore the latest text edit made by Alfred, if the file has not changed since.

browser_open_page.description: Open an HTTP(S) page in Alfred's managed Edge/Chrome window.

browser_list_tabs.description: List tabs in Alfred's managed browser with exact tab IDs.

browser_select_tab.description: Switch to an exact tab ID from browser_list_tabs.

browser_read_tab.description: Read visible text and title of the active managed browser tab.

browser_find_elements.description: Find visible links, buttons and form fields; returns stable element IDs.

args.query: semantic label or empty string for all controls

browser_click_element.description: Click one exact inspected element; may submit a form or trigger a transaction.

browser_fill_element.description: Fill one exact inspected form field with text; the website may autosave.

browser_download_element.description: Click an inspected download control and save its file to a new path.

browser_back.description: Go back in the active managed browser tab.

extract_pdf_text.description: Extract embedded text from a PDF with page numbers; use next_page to read later pages.

ocr_image.description: Recognize printed text in a local image using the preloaded OCR model.

search_documents.description: Search a text fragment in PDF, text and image files under a folder; reports when a safety limit truncates the search.

args.name_hint: optional filename fragment to narrow search

window_control.description: Focus, minimize, maximize, restore, or gracefully close a visible window. First list_windows.

download_status.description: Report progress and checksum of a tracked background download.

args.job_id: optional exact ID; omit for all jobs

list_audio_outputs.description: List active Windows playback devices and the current default.

select_audio_output.description: Switch the Windows default playback device to an exact ID from list_audio_outputs.

network_diagnostics.description: Resolve a host and test whether a TCP port is reachable.

local_network_info.description: List local network interfaces and IP addresses without contacting the internet.

create_reminder.description: Schedule an exact local reminder that Alfred will announce.

list_reminders.description: List pending local reminders with IDs and due times.

cancel_reminder.description: Cancel one reminder using an exact ID from list_reminders.
